create_joystick_env: create a joystick environment for the Booster T1 robot with configurable task and reward scales
run_joystick_step: run a simulation step on the joystick environment with an action array and return the updated state
sample_joystick_command: sample a random joystick command with linear and angular velocity targets for the T1 robot
build_reward_functions: build reward functions for tracking linear velocity, angular velocity, and foot phase in the joystick task
test_termination_conditions: test termination conditions for the joystick environment including fall detection and NaN checks
